title: direct labels over legends
rule: Direct labels over legends; pie/doughnut 2–4 slices; doughnut preferred in digital. Legend only when direct labels fail; keep it readable at 200% zoom. Stacked bar: 3–4 segments. Multi-line: 3–4 series. Horizontal bar when category labels are long.
pass_when: Direct labels where they fit; pie/doughnut 2–4 slices (doughnut preferred on digital); stacked bar / multi-line 3–4; long categories use horizontal bar.
fail_when: Legend as the only labels when direct labels would fit; pie with many slices; many stacked segments or lines.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A house choice-cutoff for form controls.
